bio: Our clinic has been operating under new management the last six years. Denturist Jamie Swiscoski bought GAJ Denture Clinic in 2010, and with a quick changeover of owners, business continued as usual. A denturist for the past 15 years, Jamie attended the NAIT Denturist Technology diploma program in 2000, graduating in 2002.
